meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: Claude 会先询问你的工作内容，帮你设计一套专属的记录类型和标签，写成模式文件并安装启用；你还可以选择设置 Telegram 提醒，最后重启服务验证模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你想定制 claude-mem 的记忆内容、新建或修改模式、添加记录类型/标签等，或要求为特定记忆发送 Telegram 通知时——即使没提“mode”这个词。

say.text: 我想让 claude-mem 记住每次实验的结论和成本发现，帮我建一个专属模式。
say.note: Claude 会先采访你，再提出记录类型和标签方案。

say.text: 给现有模式加一个“客户偏好”观察类型，并对它开启 Telegram 提醒。
say.note: Claude 会修改模式并配置触发提醒。

say.text: 我不想用“mode”这个词——帮我跟踪设计决策和场地发现，附上标签。
say.note: 即使不说 mode，Claude 也会进入该流程。

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes a custom set of observation types and concept tags, writes and installs the mode file, optionally configures Telegram alerts, then restarts the worker and verifies the mode is active.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types/tags, or get Telegram alerts for specific memories—even if you don't say 'mode'.

say_en.text: Remember my experiment conclusions and cost findings in a custom mode.
say_en.note: Claude interviews you first, then proposes types and tags.

say_en.text: Add a 'client preference' observation type and enable Telegram alerts for it.
say_en.note: Claude updates the mode and sets alert triggers.

say_en.text: Track design decisions and site discoveries with tags, without saying 'mode'.
say_en.note: Even without the word mode, Claude follows this workflow.
